items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: He has performed with Buddy Rich, Jean Luc Ponty, the Rolling Stones and the Tonight Show Orchestra.

ctx.x: Saxophonist Ernie Watts was born in Norfolk, Virginia on October 23, 1945. He has performed with Buddy Rich, Jean Luc Ponty, the Rolling Stones and the Tonight Show Orchestra. Ernie’s identifiable sound kept him in demand as a first-call studio musician in Los Angeles. He currently leads his own ensembles and records with JVC Records.
Ernie was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 11, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
